text: EXHIBIT 13-4 Profit-Volume Graph* $60,000 Total Profit or Loss $40,000 $20,000 Break-even point Total \ Profit $0 orLoss $100,000 $200,000 $300,000 $(20,000) $(40,000) H(EQ.000) Total Revenues * The profit line is drawn by determining and plotting profit or loss at two different volumes and then drawing a straight line through the plotted values. Perhaps the easiest values to select are the loss at a volume of zero (with a loss equal to the fixed costs) and the volume at which the profit line crosses the horizontal axis (this is the break-even volume).
